item.title: Python Module Import Strategies: Current Directory and Subdirectory Scenarios
item.description:
“Python Module Import Strategies: Current Directory and Subdirectory Scenarios”

How does one properly structure and execute imports for local Python files, especially when dealing with modules residing in the same directory or within nested subdirectories, considering differences between Python 2 and Python 3 module resolution rules?

This discussion covers various accepted techniques for resolving import paths in Python scripts, addressing scenarios ranging from simple sibling imports to more complex package hierarchies.

item.title: Python: Locating Imported Module File Paths and Directories
item.description:
“Python: Locating Imported Module File Paths and Directories”

How can a Python developer reliably determine the absolute file path, or just the containing directory, for a module that has already been imported into the current session? This is a frequent requirement, especially when needing to access related resources or configurations within a package structure. Several techniques exist, each with specific nuances concerning execution context (e.g., running as a main script vs. an imported module).
